rule: Glycolytic benchmark: 2k row at 3.4 W/kg (about 6:50 at 95 kg, about 323 W).
summary: No peer-reviewed W/kg norm for 2k erg in non-rowers was found; the available rankings come from practitioner data. For context, 8 well-trained rowers (VO2peak 61) averaged 313 +/- 38 W in a 2k erg test, so about 323 W is roughly well-trained-rower power: ambitious for a hybrid athlete. Erg power is very reliable (about 2% CV), so the test can track progress well even though the target itself is unsourced.

sources.note: Schabort 1999: well-trained rowers' 2k mean power was 313 +/- 38 W; CV for power 2.0%.
Hyrox simulation: performance tracks VO2max, endurance volume and body fat rather than maximal strength, so engine targets matter more than strength for Hyrox.
